Thanks for the ping. Operational answers below: 

Required invoice fields our system accepts (CSV/JSON mapping):
- invoice_entity_name (string)
- invoice_entity_tax_id (string)
- purchase_order (string)
- bill_to_address (multiline string)
- cost_center_code (string)
- line_description (string, ~140 chars)
- line_amount (decimal)
- vat_indicator (enum: standard | reverse_charge | exempt)
- external_reference (optional string)

Recommendation: issue separate invoices per legal entity. Rationale: easier AR reconciliation and correct posting to separate GLs; reduces VAT liability risk on our side. We will include a reverse-charge note on the EU invoice and the customer VAT number. If Orchid insists on a single PDF, we can produce a combined PDF where invoices are batched, but AR will still post to separate entity accounts.

On the amendment: standard billing addendum is recommended for multi-entity routing so we have explicit consent to split invoice issuance — otherwise some accounting teams flag it during audits.

I also attach a quick template (redwood-split-invoice-template.pdf) showing the per-line fields we populate. Ben: can you confirm whether AR needs separate invoice numbers vs. a parent invoice with sub-lines?
